about.title: About The Workshop
paragraphs: Illuminate is an entrepreneurship initiative by Agnel Polytechnic Vashi's E-Cell designed to help students step into the startup world.

The workshop takes participants through the fundamentals of entrepreneurship, from generating and identifying problems to developing business models, understanding finance, building MVPs and POCs, and presenting ideas effectively.
Through interactive activities, team-based exercises and expert guidance, participants gain practical exposure to the process of transforming ideas into potential ventures.
The workshop is open to students from any college and focuses on building entrepreneurial thinking, teamwork and confidence.

items.title: Entrepreneurship & Startup Building
items.description: Interactive sessions introducing participants to entrepreneurship and the startup-building process.

items.title: Business Model Canvas
items.description: Learn the key components of the Business Model Canvas and apply them to your own idea with expert guidance.

items.title: Finance for Entrepreneurs
items.description: Understand financial principles, financial viability and planning for entrepreneurial ideas.

items.title: MVPs, POCs & Prototyping
items.description: Explore how startups develop minimum viable products, proofs of concept and prototypes to validate ideas.

items.title: Pitching Workshop & Q&A
items.description: Present your business idea, practice pitching and receive constructive feedback.

items.title: Expert Learning
items.description: Learn directly from seasoned entrepreneurs and industry experts.

items.title: IIT Bombay Startup Kit
items.description: Receive an exclusive IIT Bombay certified startup kit.

items.title: Certificate

items.title: Hands-on Experience
items.description: Gain practical startup development and teamwork experience through activities.

items.title: Introduction
items.description: Interactive exercises designed to help participants connect with one another and become acquainted with the speaker.

items.title: What Is Entrepreneurship?
items.description: Understand the fundamentals of entrepreneurship and why it is important in today's world.

items.title: Team Formation
items.description: Participants are organized into teams to facilitate collaboration and engagement during the workshop.

items.title: Idea Generation & Problem Identification
items.description: A group activity focused on brainstorming, identifying problems and developing creative solutions.

items.title: Business Model Canvas Workshop
items.description: Learn the key components of the Business Model Canvas and understand how to apply it to a chosen idea.

items.title: Team Activity: Filling Out BMC
items.description: Teams identify challenges, devise solutions and collaboratively complete their Business Model Canvas.

items.title: Break
items.description: One-hour break.

items.title: Finance for Entrepreneurs
items.description: Understand financial principles relevant to entrepreneurship, including financial viability and planning.

items.title: Insights Into Startup Development
items.description: Explore MVPs, POCs, prototyping and ways to validate ideas through iterative testing and refinement.

items.title: Pitching Workshop & Q&A
items.description: Present your business idea in groups and participate in a Q&A session to improve pitching skills and receive feedback.

items.title: Full Attendance
items.description: Students must attend the entire workshop from 10 AM to 4 PM to receive the certificate and kit.

items.title: Active Participation
items.description: Active participation in all team activities is mandatory.

items.title: Follow Instructions
items.description: Students should follow instructions provided by faculty members and student coordinators.

items.title: Discipline & Respect
items.description: Discipline and respect towards the speaker and fellow participants must be maintained.

items.title: Certificate Eligibility
items.description: Certificates will be issued only after the college completes full payment.

items.title: Correct Certificate Details
items.description: Participants must enter their correct name and spelling for certificates. Changes cannot be made later.
